title: Hit or Miss on Value
body: Y'all's socks are nice quality and it was nice getting surprise designs but I've noticed that while some boxes are a nice deal it's often only a little cheaper than buying socks individually and getting exactly what you like. For instance, this month, even considering shipping wouldn't be free if I bought them outside of the subscription, it's at best a $4.52 discount if I include shipping as part of the value of the socks. If it's socks only it actually would have been $1.48 cheaper to just buy them myself instead of getting the subscription, with the added value of being able to pick out the socks I like best. This is because socks that are on sale are often included in this subscription box. Now, it might work out on average but this is the second month that it's been like this for me and so it's just not worth it for me.
